title: "New 2 metre repeater using AllStarLink"

## AllStarLink notes

- AllStarLink has added features that make it easier to connect to remote repeaters and hubs. [allstarlink.org](https://www.allstarlink.org/)
- Compact AllStar nodes using a Raspberry Pi are a common way to stand up a personal repeater link. [EMDRC how-to](https://www.emdrc.com.au/all-star-how-to-do-it/)
- The West Australian Repeater Group has published AllStar how-to guides. [WARG](https://www.warg.org.au/how-to-guides/)
